_note: Configuration snapshot for the KelpDAO / LayerZero OFTAdapter pathway that was exploited on 18 Apr 2026. Values reflect the publicly documented 1-of-1 DVN configuration on the Unichain -> Ethereum receive pathway. This file exists so ConfigAuditor has a real, worked regression case: it must flag DVN-INSUFFICIENT-REDUNDANCY as CRITICAL. Do NOT treat it as a template - run the auditor against it to see what a bad config looks like.

pathways._incident: A forged packet claiming a Unichain source transaction (which never existed) was attested by this single compromised DVN and released 116,500 rsETH (~$292M).

multisigs._incident: This pauser stopped the second forged packet (40,000 rsETH, ~$100M) 46 minutes in - but at 1-of-5 any single signer can halt transfers.
